name: People Taking Advantage Of You
overview: Scripture instructs believers to respond to those who may take advantage of them with integrity and patience rather than retaliation. We are called to walk uprightly and not harden our hearts against those in need, reflecting God's compassion and justice. Instead of seeking revenge, we are to trust the Lord for deliverance and extend forgiveness, following the example of Christ. Ultimately, treating others as we would want to be treated embodies the law and the prophets, guiding us to act with grace even in difficult relationships.
